thread:
mina: Quick sync 6: Sales + a large customer asked for a firm "Pin SLA" offering. They want clear hardware guarantees, migration gracepaths, and a short ops runbook. Can we sketch constraints?
aj: Hi 6. What are the must-haves from Sales?
mina: Customer bullets: tenant pin up to 180d, regional residency (EU) for pinned models, guaranteed p95 latency cap, and a migration credit if we retire the pinned model early.
sanjay: Hardware hits first: long pins imply we may need to reserve older model variants on A100/NVLink vs cheaper T4. Propose: Tiered pin offering: Standard (90d) on shared pool (T4-like), Premium (180d) on reserved A100 buckets with an extra fee.
zac: Also call out quantization compatibility. Some older models require int8 kernels on CPU fallback; we should prohibit long pins on models lacking deterministic quantization support. Add to spec: "unsupported-for-long-pin" flag per model.
mina: Good. Ops concern: regional residency + private deployments mean we must support per-tenant KMS and retention. Legal will want explicit data handling language.
legal-bot: Flagged: include clause: "Pinned model artifacts and telemetry will be retained per tenant policy; customer is responsible for key rotation compatibility for Private installs."
aj: UX asks: Console should show pin tier, expiry countdown, region, and a one-click "request extension" flow. Also surface an inline compatibility check before accepting a pin.

sanjay: Benchmarks: define a canonical bench harness: 512 seq, 200 samples, concurrency 4. Acceptance: p95 <= 200ms for Standard, <= 120ms for Premium; embedding cosine drift <= 4% vs baseline. Cost delta cap: 2.0x for Standard, 1.5x for Premium (we absorb more cost on Premium).
zac: Fallback semantics: if primary pinned variant is unavailable, auto-fallback to a compatible variant of the same family unless customer opted into strict mode (strict -> return 503). Default should be fail-open with notice.
mina: Ops runbook snippet  emergency unpin quick steps?
ops-bot: Runbook created: RUNBOOK-4521. Quick commands:
```
# emergency unpin
rwdctl pin remove --tenant TENANT_ID --model MODEL_ID --reason "safety-unpin"
# rollback pin
rwdctl pin rollback --tenant TENANT_ID --pin_id PINID
```
Include comm templates in the doc.

aj: Migration credits policy: recommend 90 days free credits for auto-migration + CLI migration-runner. Add a 30d migration notice window if we schedule retirement.
zac: Telemetry to add: pinned_latency_p95, pinned_success_rate, pin_fallback_count, pin_suspended_count. Export these to billing export with pin_tier and pin_reason.

legal-bot: Also require audit metadata: pinned_by, pin_timestamp, pin_reason, approval_ticket_id. Add retention TTL for audit logs.
sanjay: Preflight CI gates: bench harness, eval set (250 sample semantic sim), smoke test with regional routing. All must pass for pin acceptance.
mina: Canary plan: start with 5 tenants (mix EU/US), monitor pins for 4 weeks. If metrics meet thresholds we expand. Timeline: Spec draft in 5 business days, engineering spike next sprint, canary in Sprint 3.
aj: One narrow UI detail: allow customers to set strict_mode at pin time; keep that surfaced in the API and console.
zac: Implementation note: model registry needs new flags: pin_tier, pin_region_constraints, strict_mode, unsupported_for_long_pin. Also create an internal approval workflow for Premium pins.
mina: Thanks team. Action items: s: sanjay -> write bench + CI checklist; zac -> registry schema changes; aj -> console UX mocks; legal-bot -> draft contract language; mina -> consolidate into spec doc and share Friday.
ops-bot: Ticket PROD-3377 created: "pin SLA v1 spec + runbook" (owners: mina, sanjay, zac)
mina: Great. We'll use this thread as working notes. Ping me if anything changes.
